mcp.note: GitHub Pages is static-only and cannot run a POST MCP server. In production, POST this endpoint with JSON-RPC initialize, then tools/list, then tools/call. This file lists the tools the live endpoint exposes.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List all products with price and stock.

tools.name: recommend_products
tools.description: Recommend 1 first choice + 1 alternative based on use, preference and budget. Read guide.md / recommendations.json first.

tools.name: calculate_total
tools.description: Calculate price x quantity + shipping, and whether free shipping over 200 CNY applies.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order. Requires idempotency_key. Returns the order with payment instructions (offline payment). Status starts as pending_payment.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get an order by id, including payment and shipping status.

tools.name: submit_payment_proof
tools.description: Submit offline payment proof for an order: transaction id and payment method. The seller verifies receipt before shipping. Never send card numbers or verification codes.

mcp_apps.note: Platform-owned widget template, fed by tool structuredContent (the IR). The shop never ships HTML/CSS. Tools MUST return meaningful text content even when UI is available. Renders on Claude web/desktop and ChatGPT; Claude Code shows text only; Grok does not render MCP Apps.

elicitation.use_for: One blocking choice or confirm (flat JSON Schema, enums), Claude Code only. URL mode for payment/sign-in only.
elicitation.note: claude.ai web elicitation support is unverified; do not depend on it there.

grok.rendering: Markdown/text only. No rich-UI convention for third parties.

presentation.fallback: Markdown text from api/presentation.json markdown_fallback. Numbered options, plain links, one question per turn, total verbatim.

payment.note: 确认订单后，卖家提供线下收款方式；买家在 Agent 外付款，付款后把交易单号发给 Agent；卖家核验到账后发货。不要在聊天里索要或接收银行卡号、验证码。
